title: planNames
body:
## planNames

Plan what each photo would be called and which folder it would go in, from recorded capture time and camera text, with a closed token vocabulary, a declared sanitiser and collision rules, and a deterministic name plan and table. Nothing is renamed or copied.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Names come from recorded capture facts, which can be wrong; a plan does not certify when or where a photo was taken.
- The sanitiser targets portable names; a destination file system can still apply its own rules, and collisions outside the run are out of scope.
- A plan is valid only for the captured bytes it lists.

Native binding: `no native write: names are host logic over typed capture facts; the same fixed listing used by inspectMetadata anchors the reads the names come from`. Output kind: `["text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `name` | The file name as a list of 1 to 12 parts, each a literal or a closed token: capture date, capture time, camera make or model, the original stem, the item ID or a sequence number. There is no template language, expression or regular expression. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":12,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"token":{"type":"enum","values":["cameraMake","cameraModel","captureDate","captureTime","day","itemId","month","originalStem","sequence","year"]},"literal":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":40},"format":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":12},"width":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":6},"start":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":999999},"scope":{"type":"enum","values":["global","perFolder","perName"]}}}}` | omitted |
| `folders` | flat puts every file in one folder; otherwise up to four folder levels from the same closed tokens (year, month, day, capture date, camera model or make, or a literal). | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"enum","values":["flat"]},{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":4,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"token":{"type":"enum","values":["cameraMake","cameraModel","captureDate","captureTime","day","itemId","month","originalStem","sequence","year"]},"literal":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":40},"format":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":12},"width":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":6},"start":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":999999},"scope":{"type":"enum","values":["global","perFolder","perName"]}}}}]}` | omitted |
| `time` | How the recorded capture time becomes name text: the basis, which source family to use and what a missing time or offset means. No system time zone, file modification time or locale is used. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"basis":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"enum","values":["recordedLocal","utc"]},{"type":"object","properties":{"fixedOffset":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":8,"required":true}}}]},"source":{"type":"enum","values":["concordantOnly","exif","xmp","iptc"]},"missing":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"enum","values":["refuseItem"]},{"type":"object","properties":{"fallback":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":60,"required":true}}}]},"missingOffset":{"type":"enum","values":["refuseItem","useRecordedLocal"]}}}` | omitted |
| `text` | What a missing camera make or model means for the name. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"missing":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"enum","values":["refuseItem"]},{"type":"object","properties":{"fallback":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":60,"required":true}}}]}}}` | omitted |
| `collisions` | refuse (default) refuses every item of a group whose names are equal after case folding and Unicode normalisation and lists the members; sequence adds -2, -3 and so on in manifest order and declares it. An image and its sidecar are one unit. | `{"type":"enum","values":["refuse","sequence"]}` | omitted |
| `extension` | canonical (default) uses the extension of the detected container (.jpg for JPEG), keepOriginal keeps the lower-cased original suffix. A suffix that disagrees with the container is reported. | `{"type":"enum","values":["canonical","keepOriginal"]}` | omitted |
